planets.name: GJ 341 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of GJ 341 with a 7.58-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: GJ 341 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around GJ 341. Its orbit and size follow DiTomasso et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
